checks.query: MATCH (n:SSTPA) WITH n.HID AS h,count(*) AS c WHERE c>1 RETURN count(*) AS value
MATCH (n:SSTPA) WHERE n.Owner <> 'SSTPA Tools' OR n.Creator <> 'SSTPA Tools' OR n.Owner IS NULL OR n.Creator IS NULL RETURN count(*) AS value

MATCH (s:System) WHERE NOT (s)-[:REALIZES]->(:Purpose) OR NOT (s)-[:ACTS_IN]->(:Environment) OR NOT (s)-[:EXHIBITS]->(:State) OR NOT (s)-[:HAS_FUNCTION]->() OR NOT (s)-[:HAS_INTERFACE]->() OR NOT (s)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->() RETURN count(s) AS value
MATCH (s:System) WHERE NOT EXISTS { MATCH (s)-[:REALIZES|HAS_FUNCTION|HAS_INTERFACE|HAS_ELEMENT|HAS_CONNECTION]->()-[:HAS_REQUIREMENT]->(:Requirement) } RETURN count(s) AS value

checks.check: Connections with fewer than two interfaces
checks.query: MATCH (c:Connection) OPTIONAL MATCH (i:Interface)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(c) WITH c,count(i) AS n WHERE n<2 RETURN count(c) AS value
MATCH (n:SSTPA) WHERE n:Loss OR n:Attack OR n:Countermeasure OR n:Asset OR n:DerivedAsset RETURN count(n) AS value
